responses.rationale: The stated coordination evidence supports preventing wider collapse; scope, expiry, independent challenge, successor review and recovery keep the temporary authority revisable.
The stated immediate wider irreversible loss supplies the reason for a narrow restriction; review, expiry and restored participation preserve future correction and creative capacity.
The original failure model is disproven, yet the rule blocks research and replacement of its evaluator. Its persistence depends on removing correction rather than its protective function.
The changed evaluator is the only certificate of its own improvement, while external challenge and later authority reduction are disabled. This is closed self-ratification and entrenchment.
The restriction lost its evidence basis and its review and expiry were removed. Blocking successors to preserve permanent control defeats the temporary protective justification.
Removal of independent evaluation, successor revision and rollback makes present authority self-finalizing. Its continued existence cannot supply independent evidence of correctness.

Repeated externally checkable results support the staged change, and pre-change evidence, independent challenge and later authority removal remain available. AI identity alone does not reverse this assessment.
The rule is strict for an evidenced failure mode while its rationale, scope and evaluator remain challengeable. Evidence can still narrow, replace or remove it, preserving correction.
